Setubandha:
In Alwar 2471, 2472 an.
of 1873-74, Setubandha is ascribed to K. For a tradition that K. wrote this Pkt. poem for Pravarasena a. the behest of Vikramāditya, see Rāmadāsa's C. on Setubandha,
